terms.note: Azure CLI used to run graph queries and resource lookups.
Optional MCP tools used when a single-resource-type tool covers the query.
Named MCP tool for VM lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for storage account lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for Cosmos DB lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for Key Vault lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for SQL Database lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for container registry lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for AKS lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for App Service, but has no list command; must use Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for Event Hubs lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
Named MCP tool for Service Bus lookups; alternative to Resource Graph.
az CLI extension (az extension add --name resource-graph) is the core mechanism.
